fact: Benin's National AI and Big Data Strategy 2023-2027, adopted by the Council of Ministers on 18 January 2023, plans (Action 4.1) the adoption of a text on AI ethics and liability within 12 months; no AI law is yet adopted in it.
title: Stratégie Nationale d'Intelligence Artificielle et des Mégadonnées 2023-2027
publisher: Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation
